provenance.note: Ten generic SIM slots represent the ten RC1/Rally1 P1 entries published for Rally Chile 2026. The official entry-list order is not treated as a running order. The 180-second interval is a planning assumption based on the FIA P1 minimum; an official start list, event-specific instructions or Live TV intervals override it. The 13:46.4 local Rally2 result remains a motion benchmark only, not a WRC Rally1 pace forecast.
